summary.one_liner: The official Python SDK for Sentry, used to send errors, messages, and performance traces from Python applications to a Sentry project.
summary.what_it_does: Installs via pip as sentry-sdk and is initialized with sentry_sdk.init() using a DSN from a Sentry project. It captures unhandled exceptions and manual messages (capture_message) as events in the Sentry dashboard. It supports performance monitoring through a traces_sample_rate setting. The README says it integrates with many Python libraries and frameworks, naming FastAPI, Django, Celery, and OpenAI. Data collection can be limited, such as turning off user info or HTTP request/response bodies. The README also covers migration guides from 1.x to 2.x and from raven-python.
use_cases: monitor Python application errors in production
track performance of Django or FastAPI apps
log custom messages to an error dashboard
reduce collection of user data in error reports
notable: Official Sentry SDK, maintained by the Sentry project
Framework integrations including FastAPI, Django, Celery, and OpenAI
Configurable data collection to exclude user info or HTTP bodies
Migration guide from raven-python, which is in maintenance mode
caveats: Requires a Sentry account and project (a DSN) to send events
The README does not state a platform or Python version requirement
Legacy raven-python is in maintenance mode; the README points users to this SDK instead
